headline: Profit rose 6.3x in two years, but operating cash flow was negative in every year (-Rs 2,165 m in FY26) as inventory doubled; Rs 6,500 m of the Rs 8,500 m fresh issue repays debt.
red_flags: Cumulative CFO -Rs 2,311 m vs PAT Rs 2,640 m, FY24-FY26 (CFO/PAT -87.5%)
Inventory Rs 6,959 m at Mar-26, up 95% in a year; each Rs 1 of new revenue needed Rs 0.42 of working capital
Production fell 4,491 kg to 4,005 kg (FY24-FY26) while revenue doubled; ~33% of 12,000 kg capacity used
Related party Aalishaan Jewels LLP: 5.06% of FY26 sales, 4.38% of purchases; top customer; subsidiary from Apr-26
Borrowings rose to Rs 8,204 m by 31-Aug-26 from Rs 5,602 m at Mar-26
Auditor resigned Jul-25 (no peer review); two auditor appointments since
